public_payload.normalized_proposition: Most AI data center debt deals will not be repaid.

statement.excerpt: I do not think the majority of these AI data center debt deals ever get paid.

from_speaker: these AI data center debt deals
our_interpretation: This is a forecast of eventual nonpayment, despite its expression as a belief.
Majority means more than half of the deals by count, rather than by dollars lent.
The relevant population is the AI data center financing deals discussed or referenced at publication. The post does not provide a complete list.
A deal is unpaid if its final resolution leaves creditors short of the payments contractually owed. Distressed trading prices or a temporary missed payment do not establish that it never gets paid.
criteria.support_condition: A defined population of the referenced deals has final creditor shortfalls in more than half its members.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least half of that same population is fully paid or otherwise satisfied under its original contractual terms, making a majority of unpaid deals impossible.
